app.name: WON AVENUE
app.tagline: Good food in Korea — matched to your diet, in your language

passport.title: Food passport
passport.onboardTitle: Tell us what you can't eat 🍽️
passport.onboardSub: We'll mark which dishes suit you, based on the restaurant's info — in your language.
passport.setupText: Halal, vegan, allergies — we'll mark the dishes that suit you.
passport.consentAccount: I agree that WON AVENUE keeps my diet and allergy info in my account to mark dishes for me. I can delete it at any time.
passport.consentGuest: I agree to keep my diet and allergy info on this device (and in my account if I sign up).
passport.disclaimer: We mark dishes using the information the restaurant provides. It helps you choose, but it is not a medical guarantee.

dish.allergenNote: Ingredients and allergens as listed by the restaurant. With a serious allergy, please check with the restaurant.

cart.title: Cart
cart.multiNote: Your cart has dishes from {{count}} restaurants. Each restaurant gets its own order with its own delivery fee and courier — you pay once.
cart.maxRestaurants: You can order from up to {{count}} restaurants at once

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.howToReceive: How would you like to get it?
checkout.notePlaceholder: e.g. Please leave it at the door
checkout.success: Order placed! The restaurant will confirm shortly.
checkout.secure: Payments are processed securely. We never store your card number.
checkout.successMany: {{count}} orders placed! Each restaurant will confirm its own order.
checkout.noCommonOption: These restaurants don't share a way to receive the order. Remove one of them from the cart.

orders.title: My orders
orders.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? The payment will be refunded.
orders.courierOnWayHint: Your courier is on the way
orders.wrongPlaceHint: Delivered to the wrong place? Call the courier.

review.title: How was your order?
review.commentPlaceholder: Tell others about the food and service
review.photosHint: Up to 3 photos · JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to 2 MB each

auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with a letter and a number
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.registered: Account created. Add a card to start ordering.

cards.title: Add a card
cards.foreign: This card was issued outside Korea
cards.demoNotice: Demo mode: no real money is charged. Try 4242 4242 4242 4242 (any future date, any CVC). 4000 0000 0000 0002 is always declined.
cards.tossButton: Register a card with Toss Payments
cards.tossNotice: You will enter your card details securely on the Toss Payments page. Korean and international cards are supported.
cards.accepted: We accept Korean and international cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, JCB, UnionPay).

manage.title: My restaurants
manage.noRestaurants: You don't have a restaurant yet. Add one to start selling.
manage.submittedForApproval: Submitted! An admin will review and activate your restaurant.
manage.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete this category? Dishes will move to "Other".
manage.allergensHint: Tick everything the dish contains. Customers with allergies rely on this.
manage.translateHint: Your text is translated automatically for customers in 6 other languages.
manage.translateOff: Auto-translation is off. Customers will see the text as written.
manage.translateOnSave: After saving, the dish is translated into 6 languages automatically.
manage.romanizationHint: How to say the Korean name, e.g. kimchi-jjigae. Filled in automatically if empty.
manage.explanationHint: Optional. A short explanation of the dish. Written automatically if empty.
manage.manualHint: Edited by you — won't be overwritten
manage.autoHint: Automatic translation — edit to correct it
manage.moodTagsHint: Pick what fits. "Fast" is added automatically when preparation takes up to {{min}} min.
manage.isSideHint: Mark sides and drinks: they are not counted when we recommend your restaurant for a diet (e.g. fries don't make a chicken place vegetarian).
manage.hoursHint: Seoul time. Leave both empty if you are open 24 hours. Closing after midnight is fine (e.g. 16:00–04:00).

admin.title: Admin
admin.deleteRestaurantConfirm: Delete this restaurant? If it has orders it will be deactivated instead.
admin.demoText: Restore all restaurants, orders and accounts to the original demo state before a presentation.
admin.demoResetConfirm: All changes made during the demo will be lost. Continue?
admin.ordersReadOnly: Restaurants accept their orders; everything after that happens automatically. This page is for viewing only.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.notFoundText: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or was moved.
errors.forbiddenText: You don't have permission to view this page.
errors.password: At least 8 characters with a letter and a number
errors.name: 2–50 characters
errors.price: Enter a whole amount greater than 0
errors.PAYMENT_DECLINED: Your card was declined. Try another card.
errors.ITEMS_UNAVAILABLE: Some dishes are no longer available
errors.MIN_ORDER_NOT_MET: The minimum order amount was not reached
errors.RESTAURANT_INACTIVE: This restaurant is not accepting orders right now
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: This status change is not allowed
errors.REVIEW_EXISTS: You have already reviewed this order
errors.ORDER_NOT_COMPLETED: You can review only completed orders
errors.CARD_LIMIT: You can save up to 5 cards
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Image must be 2 MB or smaller
errors.INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Only JPG, PNG or WEBP images
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.DIET_CONFLICT: The dietary labels don't match the ingredients (e.g. halal with pork)
errors.DEMO_DISABLED: Demo reset is disabled on this server
errors.DELIVERY_TAKEN: Another courier already took this delivery
errors.RESTAURANT_CLOSED: This restaurant is closed right now
errors.PASSPORT_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Please agree to keep your food passport
errors.TOO_MANY_PHOTOS: You can add up to 3 photos

dishCheck.title: Dish check
dishCheck.subtitle: Dishes go live immediately. Check them when you have time.
dishCheck.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Please add egg to the allergens — the batter contains egg.
dishCheck.messageHint: If the owner doesn't fix the dish in time, it is hidden automatically.
dishCheck.ownerTitle: Admin asked you to fix {{count}} dish(es)
dishCheck.fixBy: Please fix by {{date}}, otherwise the dish will be hidden.
dishCheck.hiddenHint: Hidden from customers. Fix and save it to show it again.
dishCheck.saveToResubmit: Save your changes — the dish will be checked again.

alerts.soundHint: Play a sound when a new order arrives

scene.kitchen: The chefs are cooking your order
scene.map: Your courier is on the way (the map is illustrative)

reviewPrompt.title: How was {{name}}?
reviewPrompt.sub: Rate your order — it takes 10 seconds
